scripts.start:server: cd go-server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi && go build -o ccu-addon-mui-server-local . && exec ./ccu-addon-mui-server-local
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:server" "npm run start:fe"
scripts.postbuild: npm run remove:build && npm run copy:build && npm run tar:gz
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run test:e2e:coverage:collect && npm run test:e2e:coverage:report
scripts.test:e2e:coverage:collect: rm -rf .nyc_output coverage/playwright && mkdir -p .nyc_output && PW_COVERAGE=1 playwright test
scripts.copy:build: npm run build:go-server && mkdir -p addon_installer/dist && cp -r dist/ccu-addon-mui/* addon_installer/dist && mkdir -p addon_installer/go-server && cp go-server/ccu-addon-mui-server-arm addon_installer/go-server/ && npm run write:version
scripts.tar:gz: chmod -R 777 addon_installer/ && tar -czvf mui-$(npm run version:current --silent).tar.gz -C addon_installer .
